description: This file defines Express route handlers for managing 'Reports' in a weekly reporting platform. It sets up endpoints for creating drafts, submitting reports, retrieving reports, listing user's reports, and a placeholder for exporting reports. The routes utilize middleware for authentication, role-based access, and auditing, and delegate logic to the reportsController.

methods.name: upsertDraft
methods.description: Handles creating or updating a draft report for the current user.

methods.name: submit
methods.description: Handles submitting a draft report by its ID.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a report by ID, accessible to owners, admins, or managers.

methods.name: listMine
methods.description: Lists reports belonging to the current user.

methods.name: exportPlaceholder
methods.description: Placeholder method for exporting or sharing reports; currently not implemented.
